settings.title: 01. Unopened & Sealed Vessels
settings.body: Unopened formulations in their original sealed Travertine outer cartons may be returned within the applicable statutory return window for your jurisdiction.

settings.title: 02. Hygiene Standards for Opened Cosmetics
settings.body: For client safety and cosmetic hygiene compliance, opened or unsealed vessels cannot be restocked unless a formulation arrived damaged, defective, or incorrect.

settings.title: 03. Initiating a Return
settings.body: Contact Client Care with your order reference number to receive return authorisation and protective return-packing guidance.

settings.title: 04. Statutory Consumer Rights
settings.body: Final jurisdiction-specific return periods (including UK, EU, US, and Australian statutory withdrawal terms) are confirmed prior to regional commercial launch.

settings.heading: RETURNS & REFUNDS
settings.intro: We want every VESLORIA formulation to be chosen with clarity and confidence. Please review our cosmetic hygiene return framework below.
